name: set_comment
description: Write a regular analysis comment at a hexadecimal address and return whether readback matched. An empty comment clears it. This mutates the Hopper document; use comments to record evidence IDs or reasoning.

address.description: A provider-normalized address; default memory uses 0x-prefixed hexadecimal

comment.description: Exact analyst comment text to write.

document.description: The active target's provider document name; use open_binary to switch targets

__schema0.description: A provider-normalized address; default memory uses 0x-prefixed hexadecimal

__schema2.description: The active target's provider document name; use open_binary to switch targets
